seo_title: Tideline: Webflow Template Design | The Brandle
summary: A Webflow template for launching a single residential tower, built around a clickable floor selector.

brief.label: Webflow template, real estate
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Tideline is a Webflow template for developers launching a single residential building. It is built around the questions buyers ask first: which floor, what view, what it costs and how they pay.
The home page draws the tower as a floor selector. Click a band of the building and it opens the plan, the sizes and the starting price.

answer.label: Approved 2026
answer.heading: What's inside
paras: A view section switches between photographs taken from different levels. Each inner page has its own layout: a comparison table of residences, a level-by-level tour of the tower and a numbered map of the neighbourhood.
Under the bonnet there are 99 variables for colour, type and spacing, and 18 interactions. The floor selector is made with Webflow's own tabs, so a buyer can edit all of it in the Designer.
It was first called Corniche. Then we found a template called Cornice, one letter away, and renamed it. Webflow approved it for the Marketplace in November 2026.
